title: How Your Eye Turns Light into Pictures
post_title: How Your Eye Turns Light into Pictures | QuantaTale
post_description: A friendly walk through the eye, showing how light becomes the pictures we see. Sources: National Institutes of Health https://www.nei.nih.gov/eye-health-information/healthy-vision/how-eyes-work and National Aeronautics and Space Administration https://spaceplace.nasa.gov/atmosphere/en/ #Science #ScienceFacts #QuantaTale
narration: Light first passes through the clear front layer called the cornea, which is dome‑shaped and bends the light. The colored iris then decides how much light the pupil will let in. Next the light goes through the clear inner lens, which works with the cornea to focus the light onto the back of the eye. At the retina, special photoreceptor cells change the light into tiny electrical signals. Those signals travel through the optic nerve to the brain, where they become the images we see.
